title: Powell Industries Q4 revenue jumps 33% to $3.97B amid 162% order growth
digest:
Powell Industries reported Q4 revenue of $397 million, up 33% YoY, with net income rising 59% to $82 million (EPS $2.23). The company attributed the growth to a 162% YoY surge in new orders totaling $7.1 billion, boosting backlog to $2.7 billion. Its gross margin improved to 34.9%.

Powell noted 2027 demand is expected to remain stable but flagged potential order cancellations as a risk. The latest figures follow earlier reports detailing its expansion in renewable energy infrastructure projects, though specific guidance for 2027 was not provided beyond the demand stability assumption.

Conditions: The order growth and backlog figures are tied to renewable energy infrastructure projects, with no disclosed territorial restrictions. The margin increase reflects cost optimizations in both manufacturing and logistics, per company disclosures.
